world.title: U.S. ICE Arrests Convicted Nigerian Among ‘Worst Of The Worst’ Over Larceny, Money Laundering
world.description: U.S. ICE Arrests Convicted Nigerian Among ‘Worst Of The Worst’ Over Larceny, Money Laundering U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has arrested a Nigerian national, Raphael Oludemilade-Adebowale, who was convicted of larceny and money laundering in Massachusetts. Oludemilade-Adebowale was among several foreign nationals arrested by ICE in the United States over criminal convictions, according to a statement released by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security on Thursday.
